schema.total_gun_game_rounds_won: total rounds of Arsenal Mode won
schema.total_gun_game_rounds_played: total rounds of Arsenal Mode played

dataQuality.note: Missing Steam stat keys are stored as null and displayed as —, never coerced to 0. Accuracy falls back to the sum of weapon hits/shots when aggregate keys are missing.

matchSource.steamWebApi: Steam Web API exposes aggregate CS2 stats, not a normal per-match history feed.
matchSource.heybox: No verified Heybox match-history endpoint returned rows in this build.

heybox.note: Heybox account connected and its bound SteamID64 matches the bound Steam identity.

playnite.note: CS2 total playtime displayed on the record page uses the Playnite exported total.
